{{Top}}
{{MultipleIssues|citation|moresources}}
{{Quote|Once again we shall face each other in single combat&hellip; and the victor will decide the fate of the galaxy!|Darth Malak, to Revan|audio=MalakFateofTheGalaxy.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Young_Learner_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Darth Vader vs Luke Skywalker]]
A '''lightsaber duel''' was two or more combatants armed with [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]], or one party using lightsabers against another wielding a melee weapon capable of sparring with the former, engaged in personal [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].

Most such duels were fought by varying permutations of participants allied with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and duelists representing the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], though other parties have participated in such events, such as the [[Jensaarai/Legends|Jensaarai]]. In general, however, only beings who could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] engaged in lightsaber duels, as the dexterity and awareness required to wield such weapons necessitated extensive training in its mastery.
